paragraphs: By agreeing to the Terms of Use, you consent to receive documents, communications, notices, and disclosures relating to your account (“Disclosures”) electronically, either through the Website or to an email address you provide to us, including IRS Form 1099 and any other IRS form.

Electronic Communications. You agree that all communications from RTR Servicing may be provided or made available to you electronically on the Website or by email. If you consent, you still have the right to receive a free paper copy of any communication by contacting us in the manner described below. We may discontinue electronic Disclosures at any time in our sole discretion.

Scope of Consent. Your consent to receive Disclosures and transact business electronically applies to any and all transactions to which such Disclosures relate between you and RTR Servicing. Your consent will remain in effect until such a time as all relevant Disclosures have been made.

Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Consent. You expressly consent to receiving calls and messages, including auto-dialed and pre-recorded message calls, and SMS messages (including text messages) from RTR Servicing, our affiliates and our agents, at any telephone numbers that you have provided or may provide in the future (including any cellular telephone numbers). Your cellular or mobile telephone provider will charge you according to the type of plan you carry. See our SMS Terms.

Hardware and Software Requirements. To access and retain the communications electronically, you will need a device with a current web browser, software capable of opening PDF files, and the ability to print or save documents. You acknowledge that you can access the electronic communications in the designated formats described herein.

Mobile Technology. If you access the Website through a mobile device, such as a tablet or mobile phone, you must be able to print and save the communications. If your mobile device does not have this functionality, you must access the Website through alternate means that provide you with the ability to print and save communications.

Withdrawing Consent. You may withdraw your consent to receive Disclosures electronically by contacting us as described below. If you withdraw your consent, all previously agreed-to terms and conditions will remain in effect, and we will send Disclosures to your mailing address on file.

You can contact us by email at [support@rtrservicing.com](mailto:support@rtrservicing.com) or by calling (877) 469-7325. You may also write to us at: RTR Servicing, P.O. Box 561266, Dallas, TX 75356-1266, Attention: Compliance.

You must keep us informed of any change in your email or home mailing address so that you can continue to receive all Disclosures in a timely fashion. If your registered email address changes, you must notify us of the change by emailing [support@rtrservicing.com](mailto:support@rtrservicing.com) or calling (877) 469-7325. You also agree to update your registered residence address and telephone number if they change.
